about.text: Founded by Dhirubhai H. Ambani (Founder Chairman). Led by Mukesh D. Ambani, Chairman and Managing Director.

needles: Mukesh D. Ambani Chairman and Managing Director

about.text: Six businesses: oil to chemicals (O2C), oil and gas, retail, digital services (Jio), media and entertainment (JioStar) and new energy. Workforce of 4,19,911.

group.note: RIL's share of each company, from the list of subsidiaries and associates in the annual report.

segments.name: Oil to Chemicals (O2C)
segments.what: Refining and petrochemicals: transportation fuels, polymers and elastomers, intermediates and polyesters.

needles: Transportation Fuels, Polymers & Elastomers, Intermediates, and Polyesters

points.text: FY26: 80.0 MMT of crude and feedstock processed; 70.9 MMT of products for sale.
Q2 FY27: revenue ₹231,601 crore; EBITDA ₹25,203 crore, up 67.9%, its best quarter so far.
Jio-bp fuel retail network of 2,304 outlets.
The company describes Jamnagar as the world's largest refinery.

segments.name: Oil and gas
segments.what: Deep-water and ultra-deep-water gas and oil fields in the KG basin, and coal-bed methane (CBM).

points.text: FY26: average gas production of 26.7 MMSCMD, about 30% of India's domestic output.
Q2 FY27: KG-D6 averaged 24.0 MMSCMD of gas and about 15,903 barrels a day of oil and condensate; CBM 1.04 MMSCMD.

segments.name: Digital services (Jio)
segments.what: Mobile, home broadband and enterprise connectivity, plus digital platforms, held through Jio Platforms.

points.text: Q2 FY27: 542.4 million customers; average revenue per user ₹218.8 a month; monthly churn 1.6%; 44.2 GB of data per user a month.
300 million 5G users and 30.0 million broadband homes, 15.1 million of them on Jio AirFiber.
Jio Platforms Q2 FY27: revenue ₹47,485 crore (up 11.3%), EBITDA ₹21,879 crore (up 16.6%).

segments.name: Retail
segments.what: Consumer electronics, grocery, fashion and lifestyle, and connectivity, in stores and online (JioMart, AJIO).

needles: Consumer Electronics, Grocery, Fashion and Lifestyle, and Connectivity

points.text: FY26: 20,160 stores, 78.3 million sq ft, 387 million registered customers, about 1.9 billion transactions.
Q2 FY27: 19,947 stores after 303 openings and a net reduction of 222; gross revenue ₹91,716 crore, up 6.4%.
JioMart revenue up 42% in Q2 FY27, served from 5,000+ stores across 1,000+ cities.
Management says FY27 builds online scale and FY28 to FY29 converts scale into value.

needles: FY28 – FY29 converts scale into value

segments.name: Media and entertainment (JioStar)
segments.what: TV channels, the JioHotstar streaming app, sports and news (Network18).

points.text: FY26: JioHotstar averaged 451 million monthly users; a record 72.5 million watched at once during the T20 World Cup 2026.
Q2 FY27: about 440 million monthly users (up 10%); revenue ₹6,806 crore.
Provision for loss-making content contracts at JioStar: ₹17,742 crore at 31 Mar 2026, after ₹8,018 crore was used in FY26.

segments.name: New energy
segments.what: Solar modules and cells, batteries, electrolysers and green hydrogen at Jamnagar, and solar power in Kutch.

points.text: Solar: heterojunction (HJT) cell and module lines being commissioned, Phase I operating; the plant is to scale to 10 GWp a year.
Batteries: giga-factory in advanced commissioning, 40 GWh a year with a roadmap to 100 GWh; production to ramp up through the second half of 2026.
Hydrogen: alkaline-electrolyser technology licensed from Nel ASA; target of 3 MMTPA green-hydrogen-equivalent capacity by 2032.

needles: 3 MMTPA of green hydrogen equivalent capacity by 2032

points.text: Kutch: solar project across 5,50,000 acres, up to 55 MWp a day at peak deployment.
Management expects New Energy to contribute to earnings from FY28.

revenue.basis: Gross value of sales and services, before sales between segments

recent.title: Q2 FY27 results
recent.text: Revenue ₹362,268 crore (up 27.8%), EBITDA ₹62,409 crore (up 23.9%), profit ₹29,550 crore (up 33.8%). Net debt ₹117,140 crore, 0.47 times annualised EBITDA.

recent.title: Board approves more debentures
recent.text: Enabling resolution to issue non-convertible debentures of up to ₹15,000 crore by private placement.

recent.title: Hamleys franchising company to be struck off
recent.text: A UK step-down subsidiary, Hamleys (Franchising) Ltd, is being struck off. Its 2025 turnover was ₹56.08 crore, 0.0048% of RIL's consolidated turnover.

recent.title: Jio Platforms listed
recent.text: Jio Platforms listed on NSE and BSE after an IPO of 27 crore new shares at ₹1,119 each, raising ₹30,188 crore. About ₹27,500 crore goes to repaying Reliance Jio Infocomm's foreign-currency loans early.

recent.title: ICRA ratings
recent.text: ICRA reaffirmed AAA (Stable) on ₹12,000 crore of debentures and A1+ on ₹10,000 crore of commercial paper, and assigned AAA (Stable) to ₹50,000 crore of bank loans.

recent.title: Customs order
recent.text: Fine and penalty of ₹18,74,978 for alleged misclassification of imported goods. The company plans to appeal and says operations are not affected.

needles: There is no impact on operati

recent.title: Debentures issued
recent.text: Allotted 13,00,000 unsecured debentures of ₹1 lakh each (₹13,000 crore), after 12,00,000 (₹12,000 crore) on 16 Sep.

recent.title: Enterprise AI joint venture with Meta
recent.text: Reliance and Meta invested ₹855 crore in the ratio 70:30 to build AI products for Indian businesses on Meta's Llama models.

needles: 855 crore in the ratio of 70% and 30%

recent.title: Google partnerships
recent.text: Jio users get 18 months of Google AI Pro (Gemini) free; Reliance is building a dedicated Google Cloud region at Jamnagar.

needles: 18 months of complimentary access to Google AI Pro

recent.title: Dividend
recent.text: Final dividend of ₹6 a share for FY26, ₹8,119 crore in all (₹5.50 a share for FY25).
